messages:
OncallBot: ALERT: anomaly detector flagged a spike in both 5xx rate and downstream quality regressions for model rwi-3b in us-west-2. Rule: latency>300ms AND quality-score-drop>8% over 15m. Pager -> oncall SRE (Sara).

Sara (SRE): paging @Mike for model-quality triage. I'm taking primary and will coordinate rollback/pinning if needed. Observed: 5xx rate ~0.9% (baseline 0.05%), median latency up ~2x. Quality evals show BLEU-like drop on our key prompt set.

Mike (ML Eng): on it. pulling the latest canary logs and eval diffs. Repro locally on a sampled batch. Looks like new kernel path + a quant change from last deploy. Not a data drift signal. Will detail shortly.

Katie (Research): seeing increased hallucination rate on the regression suite (summarization tests). Severity: customer-visible for long-form outputs. Suggest pin to last known-good model @20260228 and route traffic to rwi-3b-compatible fallback.

Sara (SRE): agreed. Mitigation plan: (1) pin project prod -> rwi-3b@20260228 (2) update routing to fallback rwi-3b-compat in us-west-2 (3) post status page + customer notification draft. Will run steps in that order. Any objections?

Mike (ML Eng): no objections. I'll prepare a canary with the pinned artifact and sanity-run evals. If that passes, proceed to pin.

Ryan (Runtime): I can push routing change and throttle new model launches. Watch out for KV-cache incompatibilities when switching variants; we should clear affected caches in the pool.

Sara (SRE): executing pin now. Command we will run:
```
# pin model for prod project
redwoodctl model pin --project prod --model rwi-3b --revision 20260228 --reason "emergency rollback: quality regression"
```
I'll wait for confirmation from @Mike and @Ryan before promoting the routing change.

OncallBot: Deploybot: model-pinning job queued (job_id=pin-8421). Notifying owners.

Mike (ML Eng): pin job looks good in CI. Running quick eval (10k samples subset). ETA ~8m.

Beth (Customer Ops): heads-up: we should prepare a short customer-facing note for customers who have explicit model pins or are on dedicated capacity. I can send immediate Slack/email drafts once you confirm scope.

Katie (Research): quick eval results: pinned revision 20260228 matches baseline quality within noise; hallucination rate down to baseline. Looks good to me.

OncallBot: Job pin-8421 completed SUCCESS.

Ryan (Runtime): routing update ready. Command to run:
```
# route traffic away from latest deploy in us-west-2 to fallback
redwoodctl route update --region us-west-2 --from-model rwi-3b@latest --to-model rwi-3b-compat --weight 100 --drain-grace 30s
# clear KV cache on affected nodes
redwoodctl runtime cache flush --pool rwi-3b-usw2
```
I'll kick that and monitor token latency/5xx.

Sara (SRE): please kick it, @Ryan. I'll monitor SLOs and paging.

Ryan (Runtime): routing applied. Observing metrics… 5xx down to 0.07%, median latency back to ~baseline within 5 minutes. Re-evaluating quality signals — they look steady.

Sara (SRE): good. Drafting status page and customer note now. Posting suggested status page text below for review.

Sara (SRE): STATUS PAGE DRAFT (please review):
"We are investigating an issue affecting text generation models in the us-west-2 region. Some customers experienced degraded output quality and increased error rates after a recent model rollout. Impact: requests to model rwi-3b may have returned lower-quality responses or transient errors. Mitigation: we have pinned production traffic to a previously validated model revision and routed traffic to a compatible fallback in us-west-2. Customers using pinned revisions are unaffected. Next update: 30 minutes or when we have a resolution. If you use Dedicated/Private deployments, contact support for tailored guidance."

Mike (ML Eng): approve. Suggest adding: root cause likely regression introduced by quantization kernel change in the last deploy. "Investigating" -> "Mitigated" once metrics hold for 1 hour.

Beth (Customer Ops): customer email (short):
"Hi — we detected a model regression impacting rwi-3b in us-west-2 and have rolled back to a validated revision. If you saw degraded results, they should be resolved now. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with a detailed postmortem. Contact support if you need immediate assistance or want us to pin your org to the good revision."

Sara (SRE): sending status page update now. Also pinging #customers to prepare inbound messages.

OncallBot: STATUS UPDATED: Incident status -> Mitigated. Update posted on status.redwood.ai (incident id: INC-2420012345).

Alex (oncall-next): I'm taking handoff in 20m. Anything I should watch for?

Sara (SRE): watch 5xx rate and our regression evals (key-prompt-set). We're keeping the pin until we validate the rollback candidate and fix the kernel/quantization issue. Action items for next shift: (1) assist ML in reproducing kernel change locally, (2) verify no customer-specific regressions, (3) prepare postmortem.

Katie (Research): logging all failing prompts to the regression dashboard (link). We'll attach examples for the postmortem.

Beth (Customer Ops): I sent the short email to customers on the impacted list and posted a message to the customer Slack channels. A few direct replies coming in; I'll route them to support and escalate if urgent.

Sara (SRE): OK team — I'll close this Slack thread when metrics remain stable for 1 hour and postmortem timeline is set. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

OncallBot: REMINDER: handoff checklist — confirmed routing change? yes. postmortem owner assigned? pending (Sara to assign). communication posted? yes. monitoring threshold alerts re-enabled.

Alex (oncall-next): taking it. TY.

Sara (SRE): assigning postmortem owner: Mike (ML Eng) + Sara (SRE). ETA postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow.

Mike (ML Eng): will prepare root cause analysis and revert plan. Thanks all.

Beth (Customer Ops): keeping customers updated. I'll add a note to follow up after the postmortem.

OncallBot: THREAD CLOSED for now (metrics stable). Further updates will be posted to incident page INC-2420012345.
